title: Funding rate accrues while the market is paused, socialising losses on unpause
body: pause halts trading but does not freeze the funding accumulator. When the market is unpaused after an incident, every open position settles a funding debt for a period in which no participant could adjust or close, and undercollateralised accounts are liquidated for an exposure they had no way to manage. Snapshot the funding index at pause and resume accrual from that snapshot rather than recomputing from the elapsed wall clock time.

title: Liquidation reward paid from the insurance fund can be gamed by self liquidation
body: An account can open a position sized so that a single adverse tick makes it liquidatable, then liquidate itself and collect the fixed liquidator bonus from the insurance fund. Because the bonus is a flat amount rather than a fraction of the seized collateral, the strategy is profitable for dust positions and drains the fund without any bad debt being cleared. Scale the reward with the notional actually closed and require a minimum position size.

title: Harvest can be sandwiched to capture yield accrued by long term depositors
body: harvest realises accrued rewards in one transaction and immediately increases the share price. A searcher deposits in the block before harvest, is credited shares at the pre harvest price, and withdraws in the block after, capturing yield that accrued over weeks to other depositors. Stream the harvested reward linearly over a vesting window so that the share price cannot step, or charge an exit fee inside the window.

title: Strategy loss is not reported so withdrawals are served first come first served
body: When the underlying strategy loses principal, the vault continues to redeem shares at the last recorded price until the balance is exhausted. Early withdrawers exit whole and the remaining depositors absorb the entire loss. The vault must call report on the strategy before every redemption path, mark the loss against totalAssets, and let the share price fall so the loss is socialised proportionally at the moment it is recognised.

title: Replay of a message across bridge redeployments because nonce state is not namespaced
body: The processed nonce mapping lives in the bridge contract, so redeploying the bridge after an upgrade resets it to empty while old validator signatures remain valid. Every message that was already executed against the previous deployment can be replayed against the new one. Namespace the nonce by the source chain and by a bridge instance identifier included in the signed payload, and migrate the processed set as part of the upgrade rather than starting from zero.

title: Validator set update applies without a quorum of the outgoing set
body: updateValidators is guarded by a single owner key rather than a threshold signature from the current validator set. Compromise of that one key is sufficient to install an attacker controlled set and mint arbitrary wrapped supply on the destination chain. Require a supermajority attestation from the outgoing set for any change to the set itself, and enforce a delay between the attestation and the activation so a compromise can be observed.

title: Exchange rate is derived from a balance that a donation can inflate
body: getExchangeRate divides the raw token balance held by the contract by totalSupply. Anyone can transfer the underlying to the contract directly, raising the rate without any corresponding liability, which is enough to push borrowers on an integrating money market past their liquidation threshold or to mint free credit. Track deposits in an internal accounting variable that only the deposit path may increment, and ignore unaccounted balance.

title: Withdrawal request can be griefed by a dust deposit that resets the cooldown
body: deposit writes block.timestamp into the cooldown field of the recipient, and anyone may deposit on behalf of any address. An attacker can send one wei to a target immediately before their unstake window opens, resetting the cooldown and postponing the exit indefinitely at negligible cost. Key the cooldown to the individual withdrawal request rather than to the account, and disallow deposits credited to a third party.

title: Settlement price is read at exercise time rather than at expiry
body: exercise reads the current oracle price instead of the price recorded at the expiry timestamp. A holder can wait for a favourable move after expiry and exercise then, converting a European option into a free American option with unbounded look back. Record the settlement price in a permissioned settle call at expiry, or read the historical round whose updatedAt straddles the expiry, and reject exercise before settlement has been recorded.

title: Collateral released before the option is marked exercised
body: exercise transfers the collateral to the holder and only afterwards sets the exercised flag on the option struct. A contract holder re-enters exercise from its receive function while the flag is still false and collects the collateral for every option in the series. Set the exercised flag before the transfer, and add a reentrancy guard to every function that moves value out of the contract.
